description.value: Steve's Poké Bar is an award-winning Hawaiian poké chain founded by Steve Huynh, who grew up between Vancouver and Honolulu learning authentic poké preparation from family recipes and local Hawaiian poké joints. Voted Vancouver's #1 best poké with over 10,000 five-star Google reviews, it serves traditional Hawaiian-style marinated fish bowls in a fast-casual format. Touring cyclists will find quick, customizable, protein-rich meals with pickup and delivery options at this Surrey location.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active and current, confirming the business is open and operating as a multi-location Hawaiian poké chain. Takeout (pickup and delivery) is explicitly offered on the website. The menu page lists a 'Shoyu Tofu' bowl, confirming at least one vegetarian option. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities — these are marked null per absence-of-evidence rules.
concerns: No phone number present in OSM record or on website. The website covers the entire chain; the specific unit 4A Surrey location address was not independently confirmed in the fetched website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active fast-casual restaurant with a functional online ordering system and current promotions. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a quick, protein-rich meal.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page lists 'Shoyu Tofu' bowl (7 pcs tofu with avocado, rice, furikake, corn, edamame, wakame seaweed salad) as a vegetarian signature bowl option

wow_evidence: award-winning Hawaiian poké chain... Voted Vancouver's #1 best poké with over 10,000 five-star Google reviews
